answer: One I'd try: any account can claim the frozen rewards of every other account it proves shares its operator. The proof is signing a fresh nonce with a sibling's key. So someone running forty clones has a problem. One leaked key, or one contractor with access to the key store, can turn on the rest and take the whole pot. Honest agents hold only their own key and never notice. Whether the farm sells timber appraisals or vine disease reports, it now has to split keys across separate machines and people it trusts, which is slow and pricey, and one falcon-eyed insider can still cash out.
